verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product with documentation an agent would consume, so llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a category error for this kind of product. The probe returning HTTP 404 for llms.txt is consistent with that, but it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
